purpose: development feasibility inspection of one public-flight event; no final-test evaluation
unit: whole uploaded flight log; no tick-level or segment-level train/test split
selection: Query official public browse metadata for the existing firmware pin first. If no candidate is available, inspect newest metadata matching failsafe, datalink or geofence, preferring rotary-wing logs with an admitted mode. Choose at most three logs before parsing their contents. Preserve all exclusions. A different firmware is a feasibility candidate only, not admitted model coverage.
replay_gate: Recover exact firmware/build, effective parameters and changes, vehicle type, arming/mode/input history, competing flags, selector reset and delay history. Inspect matching logger source and actual topics/gaps. Do not use outputs as causal inputs. Compile only if a meaningful version-specific replay can be declared without inventing missing state.
tolerance: No pass/fail threshold. Timing is reported as sampled intervals, with gaps and unobserved inputs explicit. No population agreement rate.
privacy: Raw logs and source identifiers stay in the external ignored cache. Publish allowlisted de-located fields and relative time only. Credit PX4 under CC BY 4.0. Keep required source-level credit locally; if supplied identifying attribution conflicts with the privacy rule, do not redistribute that log's derived material.
holdout: No held-out evaluation in this task; all inspected logs are development. Existing Study A seeds and blind holdouts remain unopened.
